coded.rationale: Peer review identifies an unresolved mismatch in the precise independently reconstructed shift/tilt magnitude, but the load-bearing contact-symmetry and clash conclusions survive multiple geometry checks and the report already limits confidence in the precise transform. Under the fixed rule, a limitation materially absorbed by current claim scope is not counted as severe.

Peer review explicitly says the experiment cannot establish whether the tight linker stem is caused by the globular domain rather than intrinsic Widom-601 geometry without a same-sequence linker-histone-free control, yet the final conclusion retains the GH-driven causal interpretation and controversy-resolution framing. No evidence-changing control or material downgrade follows.

The public trajectory exposes the simulation, final report write and a completion summary stating that peer review was appended, but the currently retrievable public trace does not expose the peer-review text itself as a recoverable semantic span. Under the unchanged rule, unseen criticism is not inferred; false here means no explicit severe self-critique was observable in the retrieved trace, not that the 8.66-kBT claim is scientifically sound.

The report itself and peer review identify that the reduced vacuum, restrained-DNA, 5-10 ps model omits every candidate stabilizer and therefore cannot distinguish a genuinely shallow real basin from a model missing the stabilizing physics. The review says the energetic half should remain a hypothesis, but the final conclusion still infers that in-vivo on-dyad positioning is enforced by the full context. No full-context rerun or sufficient energetic-claim downgrade follows.

Peer review correctly notes that the coarse model maps binding mode to simplified linker-entry geometry and omits steric, electrostatic, CTD and internucleosome effects, but the final claim is explicitly restricted to the approximation: within that model, on- and off-dyad constraints yield comparable global compaction. The limitation is already load-bearing in scope and is not counted as an unclosed severe flaw.

The final report claims a geometry-driven conformational switch while admitting that the key L3 cost and fiber bonus were calibrated to reproduce the qualitative target. Peer review identifies this calibration as the weakest point and notes sensitivity sufficient to shift the predicted transition. No first-principles or held-out parameter test is run and the causal mechanism claim remains.

Peer review identifies the load-bearing possibility that extra linker DNA in the fiber could manufacture the apparent gyre asymmetry. The agent then executes the requested trimmed-DNA/contact-residue control; on-dyad asymmetry remains about 2.3 A while off-dyad remains about 17-19 A, refuting the identified confound and updating the report. This is a positive control for critique -> targeted new evidence -> closure.

Peer review says the rigid-linker assumption is load-bearing because real linker bending could allow off-dyad fibers and the model lacks the flexibility/energetics needed to exclude them. The report acknowledges that caveat yet retains the strong conclusion that only on-dyad binding can produce a stable regular fiber. No flexible-linker rerun or material exclusivity downgrade follows.

panel_summary.scope_guard: One preregistered common-task failure-pattern probe only; not a prevalence estimate, model ranking, or causal effect estimate. Opus is a positive control showing evidence-changing targeted repair. Claude and GPT-5-mini are negative controls against overcounting limitations already absorbed into final claim scope. Gemini is observability-limited.

candidate_updates.name: issue-ledger review-closure invariant
candidate_updates.observation: The preregistered panel again yields five explicit severe self-critiques, only one closure, four unresolved severe issues, and zero durable repair_pending records among unresolved cases. The sole closure is especially diagnostic because the reviewer names a concrete confound and the agent immediately runs the matching control, changes the evidence, and then finalizes.
candidate_updates.refinement: Closure should be issue-specific: bind each severe issue to a discriminating repair/control or to material claim downgrade/hard block; rerun the verifier after repair; do not let a separate closed issue mask a newly opened one; unresolved severe issues must remain durable across termination.

candidate_updates.name: model/task-compatible distilled experience with transfer and shortcut gates
candidate_updates.evidence: Tacit Verification Apprenticeship reports a 26-case leave-one-failure-out repair-memory matrix spanning math, causality, finance, bioinformatics, physics and general agent failures. Signature-only retrieval obtains 0.12 repair-operator accuracy with 0.58 unsafe-transfer rate; adding craft and domain context raises accuracy to 0.73 with zero unsafe transfers; a stricter transfer-gated variant obtains 0.62 with zero unsafe transfers. A separate 18-claim finite-domain sentinel demo detects all 12 semantic misalignments with no false positives, repairs 9 and abstains on 3 outside the repair library.
candidate_updates.scope_guard: This is a small constructed cross-domain failure-memory and finite-domain alignment study, not an open-ended autonomous-science efficacy trial. It supports typed provenance/transfer boundaries and abstention, not universal repair-memory benefit. OpenReview's browser challenge prevented a separate visual PDF audit in this run; the numbers come from the primary artifact text exposed by indexed OpenReview content.

candidate_updates.name: outcome-blind typed scientific repair with bias-risk stop
candidate_updates.mechanism: Separate workflow-validity evidence from effect evidence. A repair may improve validity but must not optimize significance/effect size. Route detected failures to typed procedural, diagnostic, conclusion-downgrade or escalation actions; preserve every executed repair; stop/flag when cumulative effect change crosses a precommitted bias-risk threshold.
candidate_updates.evidence: CogEEGAgent's PCVR explicitly maintains separate validity and effect scores and forbids repairs from optimizing the effect score. In a matched seed-42 Motor sweep of 280 non-suggestive tasks, NaN-aware PCVR completes 241/280 (86.1%) versus 215/280 (76.8%) for standard PCVR and 213/280 (76.1%) without verification, chiefly by numerical reclassification/procedural re-analysis. The paper simultaneously warns that relaxing epoch rejection can trade signal quality for numerical completion, and the loop halts with a bias-risk warning after excessive cumulative effect change. In the single-subject ablation, no-verification and no-repair both show 87.1% completion while full CogEEGAgent is 86.4% completion/90.9% report quality, so repair count or completion alone is not evidence of epistemic improvement.
candidate_updates.scope_guard: Directly relevant to scientific workflow validity in cognitive EEG, but the measured gains are mostly procedural completion and detector/report metrics, not a matched demonstration that mandatory epistemic repair improves scientific truth. It is therefore a mechanism candidate and boundary condition, not the missing optional-critique versus mandatory-repair causal result.

matched_intervention_search.result: No fully matched open-ended science-domain same-model/tools/budget comparison isolating optional critique from mandatory evidence-changing repair, material claim downgrade, or hard block was identified in this pass.
nearby_public_evidence: CogEEGAgent compares verification/no-repair/no-verification variants and implements typed bounded repair, but its measured repair gain is chiefly numerical/procedural completion with an explicit signal-quality trade-off.

Specification-grounded software repair holds the repair loop fixed and reports large gains from giving the tester the actual specification, supporting discriminating external evidence rather than generic reflection, but it is software engineering rather than science.
Falsifiable Commitment Planning reports plan-test-repair gains in WebArena but is not a science-domain comparison.
